description:
[measured + modeled] Your own position against the market in one call: the liquidation
    price on each venue from THAT venue's maintenance-margin tier at this notional (read from
    the exchanges' public tables, 'estimated' where none is published), the distance from the
    current mark, how much modeled CEX leverage and how much MEASURED Hyperliquid leverage sits
    between the mark and your liquidation price on your side, the funding cost per day at the
    venue's live rate, and how often in our hourly archive price moved at least that far against
    your side within 24 h and 72 h (a frequency, not a forecast). Assumes isolated margin and
    ignores fees, so the real level is slightly nearer the entry. ONE venue (venue= given) is free; the
    12-venue comparison is an answer we price: $0.02 per call (x402), 4 prepaid credits, or a key's daily quota.
